purpose: Record user adjudication for flagged historical USDJPY cases after ChatGPT-first review. Do not retroactively relabel the frozen NVT7 beta as validated by this file.

user_judgment.notes: Green lines are TL/CH. There was a momentary downside break, but lows never shifted lower, so do not classify as descending and do not draw a descending TL. A small-Dow BR line may optionally be drawn in pink.

research_implication: TL break alone is insufficient to flip H1 direction.
Direction change needs market-structure confirmation such as a meaningful lower-low update.
A small-Dow auxiliary BR line can coexist without promoting the parent H1 structure to downtrend.

user_judgment.notes: After the HIST03 green line is broken, a cyan redraw may be used. When another valid line arrives, green can be removed, but because green is gentler the steeper cyan may instead be removed. A yellow redraw that captures the structure more broadly is preferred and green can then be retired; in hindsight it became a boundary line.

research_implication: Old reference lines are not retained forever.
Retirement depends on structural subsumption/coverage, not merely recency.
Gentler broad-structure lines can outlive steeper interim redraws.
A later redraw that captures a larger structure can legitimately replace and retire the older line.

user_judgment.notes: At this point keep the prior lines, but because both H1 and H4 TLs have been broken, this is already a phase where judgment should be based on the D1 TL.

research_implication: A broken lower-timeframe TL does not imply immediate deletion.
Decision ownership can escalate from H1/H4 to D1 after lower-timeframe structure breaks.
Lifecycle visibility and decision ownership must be modeled separately.

aggregate_findings.next_step: Build a research-only post-batch lifecycle/ownership candidate and rerun regression separately; keep original NVT7 scoped beta frozen for auditability.
